definitions.explanation: A covering for the head, worn for protection from sun or cold, or as a fashion accessory.

examples.japanese: {帽子|ぼうし}をかぶってください。
{赤|あか}い{帽子|ぼうし}が{好|す}きです。
{帽子|ぼうし}を{脱|ぬ}いでください。

notes: Uses the verb かぶる (to wear on head) and {脱|ぬ}ぐ (to take off). Counter: {個|こ}. Types include: 野球{帽|ぼう} (baseball cap), 麦わら{帽子|ぼうし} (straw hat).
